title: Enable font hinting and anti-aliasing
summary: Configure Fontconfig to enable anti-aliasing and slight hinting for smoother text rendering. This is a common configuration for improving font readability on LCD screens.

steps.explain: Edit ~/.config/fontconfig/fonts.conf and add a <match target="font"> block setting antialias, hinting, hintstyle, lcdfilter, and rgba to true, true, hintslight, lcddefault, and rgb respectively.

rollback.explain: Remove the configuration file to revert to defaults.

warnings: Incorrect XML syntax in fonts.conf can cause font rendering issues or application crashes.
